parsed.rationale: This ECG is not normal: V1–V3 show QS complexes, the R waves stay small through V4, and the ST segment is raised and convex by about 2–3 mm in V2–V3 (also V4), which fits an anterior MI that meets STEMI voltage criteria, though an old infarct with an aneurysm can look the same, so compare with a prior ECG and check troponin.
